profile.headline: Project Lead, Software Development, Automated Test, Integration
profile.summary: Highly experienced and motivated Solutions Architect, system integrator, and software developer of real-time tactical systems. Recognized for technical leadership and collaboration in resolving highly complex integration issues. Proven success in software engineering and development with a strong ability to focus teams on achieving objectives. Effective at listening, succinctly summarizing, and clearly communicating with all organizational levels from technical staff through upper-level management.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Lead Software Architect
positions.description:
BH Tech provides technical consulting, engineering, design, installation, and technology development.

1/2023 – Present: Principal Software Engineer and lead architect to provide enhanced communications to US Navy ships via commercial, low earth orbit satellite constellations and government satellites for both quality of life to sailors and tactical situational awareness.

Architect, design lead, and individual contributor in the implementation of object oriented Python scripts to support a browser based interface with external hardware components in a Linux environment. Inherited a prototype application and lead the team to create a production system including documentation, unit and integration tests, coding standards, and detailed code reviews. Source code revision control using Github. Team environment collaboration using the Agile Framework applying Agile fundamentals.

Lead migration to container technology and microservices for deployment of applications, including the implementation of power system monitor as a microservice to provide hardware communications and automated, graceful shutdown of equipment in the event of loss of system power.

Implementation of unit and pre-integration tests and emulators including hardware in the loop for power supplies, modems, smart power switches, and other proprietary hardware. Extensive integration of hardware and software. Communications using UDP/IP and SNMP version 3 for Comtech 565B modems, various uninterruptable power supplies (UPS), and custom equipment.

Responsible for augmenting BHT with direct hires, contractors, and interns. Responsible for their guidance and tasking. Substantial mentoring of software development and electrical engineering/hardware teams.

Direct collaboration, in person meetings, and successful communications and presentations to the Navy customer on requirements, design, and integration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
5/2022 – 1/2023: DevSecOps Engineer – Identified the need for a common, preconfigured development and test environment for satellite ground station software. Used the Ansible automation platform to write playbooks for the configuration and deployment of fully functional virtual workstations. 

8/2021 – 1/2023: Object Oriented Python 3.8 Software Developer
Automatic Spacecraft Command Generator: Working remotely on the Wideband Global Satcom System (WGS), provided UML design followed by Object Oriented Python implementations for automated testing of the creation and transmission of several thousand spacecraft commands to a simulator for validation of the commands. This required querying of a SQLite database,  generating commands with varying parameter values, transmission of commands to Portable Spacecraft Simulator, retrieval of transmission history, and finally comparison of transmission of new commands against golden copy from a known good database. 

Spacecraft Command Protocol Interpreter: Following Wideband Global Satcom System specifications, wrote object oriented Python scripts to consume and interpret very long hexadecimal strings of spacecraft commands by protocol. Separated, analyzed, bit swapped sections, and provided feedback of command corrections. This was used extensively in the Factory Acceptance Test to the customer in April/May, 2022.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Python (Programming Language) · Test Automation Frameworks · SQL · Ansible · Kubernetes · Data Structures · C (Programming Language) · Git · Unix · Computer Science · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Communication · Linux

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
2018 - Present: Current Role: Solutions Architect - Technical responsibility for defining architectural roadmaps and development objectives of multiple tactical mission support functions. These functional teams perform automated interface design specification (IDS) generation, integration services, performance engineering and analysis, manual and automated test authoring and execution, and 3rd party software integration. Also responsible for ongoing staff training and development, extensive mentoring, and recruiting for team growth. 

4/2018 - Present: Solutions Architect 
Automated Test Implementation - Architecting roadmap, foundation, object-oriented design, implementation, and schedule to create automated AEGIS system integration tests. Tests incorporate publish subscribe message exchanges via Data Distribution Standard (DDS), for repeatable, subcutaneous, API testing instead of high-maintenance, fragile GUI tests. Implemented workflow towards CI/CD using automated static scan analysis and unit tests prior to deployment to reduce false failures. Adhering to SOLID object-oriented design principals, DOORS requirement analysis, multi-threaded Python 3, PyUnit, Pylint, Git, Jira, Confluence, Eclipse IDE, and Agile sprints, interfacing with MySQL and MariaDB.

2018 - Present: Performance Engineering,- conducted detailed capacity planning analysis and support for proposed implementation upgrades to the AEGIS Command and Control (C2) software. By leveraging existing Performance Engineering reports, this effort required zero hours of additional test time and eliminated the need to schedule shared hardware, thereby saving multiple weeks of test and analysis work.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: 2015 - 2018: Lead C++ developer – Sole resource responsible for an engineering study to replace chassis-based Versa Module Europa (VME) Navy Tactical Data System (NTDS) technology with a standalone, Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) product. This required detailed understanding of an existing Linux kernel module and device drivers, and their interactions with user level programs to allow the use of vendor-provided software without impact to legacy software. Also created modelling and simulations for radar application.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Formally recognized with AFMS Award of Excellence, 10/2017: The AEGIS Mission Planner Java application, provided by Lockheed Martin, was experiencing instability, and the status reports and ways forward were unclear. This problem had delayed an official delivery for multiple weeks. Additionally, the developers were a close knit group and did not welcome external assistance. I was asked, directly by Lockheed Martin management, to “break into the click” and see if I could provide assistance. After many patient attempts, I was able to gain their trust, profile their running application, inspect their code, and suggest a location for debug statements. This led to the direct identification of an infinite loop in their software. In addition, I was able to mentor a young LM engineer who was having difficulty communicating issues and status to LM management. Together we wrote a summary dispelling the misinformation, detailing the problem, and providing a clear path to its resolution. 

Provided design and development of modeling and simulation for an advanced radar system. Design followed UML modelling, C++ object oriented design, and support of MATLAB simulations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer and System Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted into the dual role of Senior Software developer and Operating Environments technical lead responsible for various domestic and foreign baselines on the AEGIS Weapon System. 

Lead and sole developer responsible for the engineering study to replace chassis-based Versa Module Europa (VME) Navy Tactical Data System (NTDS) technology with standalone Commercial off the Shelf (COTS) product. This task required detailed understanding of existing Linux kernel module and device drivers and their interactions with user level programs so that vendor provided software could be used without impact to legacy software, as well as complete performance analysis comparison before and after implementation to demonstrate successful proof of concept. 

Led creation of the Performance Engineering and Analysis group. This computer engineering practice comprises capacity planning, resource and technical performance measurements (TPM's), and analysis with the intent of realizing performance requirements. Tools include Linux perf, OProfile, Collectd, Cppcheck, custom Python, Java, C++ applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, developed and maintained software components in C++ for the AEGIS phased array radar control computer system in conjunction with prime contractor Lockheed Martin. Development included embedded programming of hardware to communicate with radar and radar test hardware, inter-element communications, search, track, and scheduling algorithm maintenance.

positions.description: Taught introduction to C/C++ to undergraduate computer science and computer engineering majors.

positions.title: Senior Project Engineer
positions.description:
ACC provides industrial automation services from expanding present systems to implementing complete turnkey operations.

Successful project management of contracts up to $100,000 including supervision of engineers, electricians, panel builders, and various subcontractors.

PLC based control system design including programming, electrical and control panel design and drawings, data acquisition, simulation for testing, installation, system integration, startup, and training.

SCADA package development and configuration used on Novell network communicating with PLC system installation.
Documentation of procedures for ISO 9001 certification.
